standard_prerequisites: Lemma lemma-flat-axioms (in-source definition carrier): defines the property P of arrows of WAdm^Noeth by flatness of the relevant localizations
standard ring facts: localizations of flat ring maps are flat, and flat ring maps are stable under composition (Algebra, commutative algebra facts)
core_obligations: Let P be the property of arrows of WAdm^Noeth defined in Lemma lemma-flat-axioms. Then P is stable under composition.
proof_roadmap: For composable arrows phi : A -> B and psi : B -> C satisfying P, and any prime q of C covered by the defining condition, C_q is a localization of C, flat over B_p with p = psi^{-1}(q) by P for psi, and B_p is flat over A by P for phi; flatness transitivity under composition finishes.
The proof carries the whole argument in the single reason: compositions of flat ring maps are flat, applied to the localizations appearing in the definition of P.
difficulty_reason: H2: a one-sentence proof that is complete for a one-sentence fact; the stated reason (composition of flat maps is flat) is exactly the load-bearing step applied to the localizations defining P.
